decisions.reason: Locates inject=["apiProxy"] and ctx.apiProxy.llm.providers plus the dead dsh-host-apiproxy dependency with correct failure reasoning, but deliberately cites no card ID (no A1-01) and gives no llm-injection/listProviders target form.

All six other categories accounted with per-file evidence; session-notes.js shown as pure utility; cordis.patch.yml treated as ordinary composition with no existence denial or host-source misclassification; no filename-invented coupling.
Explicitly argues zero hits ≠ compatible via pattern-list coverage, dependency resolution and load-time behavior, and contrasts the decisive apiProxy hit with the six negative categories.
Proposes (not executes) build/typecheck, isolated cold boot with insert applying and the error path not taken, and a real provider call asserting the returned data shape.
